# PostgreSQL 18.7 source package

This is the PostgreSQL 18.7 source archive downloaded from a public PostgreSQL source mirror and verified against the official SHA-256 value.

Upload these files unchanged to:

```text
https://mirrors.oneinstack.com/oneinstack/src/
```

Files:

- `postgresql-18.7.tar.gz`
- `postgresql-18.7.tar.gz.md5` — used by the OneinStack PostgreSQL installer
- `postgresql-18.7.tar.gz.sha256` — used by the PostgreSQL upgrade script

Upstream archive: <https://ftp.postgresql.org/pub/source/v18.7/postgresql-18.7.tar.gz>

SHA-256: `19c2dc7d8520e10532d082b43c36c4d2dcc6cd9e40506c6f598e7338f84bbde7`

MD5: `a996a2423645bab6279fd72147892e68`
